# Organ Manifest: DALEOBANKS (perception, public voice, distribution).
# Generated from an in-session inspection of dababiyoda/daleobanks@829c5f28.
# Validated against contracts/organ-manifest.schema.json.
manifest_version: "1.0"
organ_id: spiffe://uniimente.internal/organ/daleobanks
name: DALEOBANKS
role: perception_media_intelligence_audience_distribution
repository: dababiyoda/DALEOBANKS
source:
  branch: main
  commit: 829c5f2810776bef65d6ea108800a3516c9f4c2b
legal_operators: [alfonso_lopez]
capabilities:
  - capability_id: daleobanks.wealthmachine_bridge
    description: >-
      Signed bridge client to WealthMachineIntelligence: OpportunityPacket out,
      VentureAssessment back; circuit breaker; deterministic mock mode with the
      same contract for offline runs.
    implementation_path: services/wealthmachine_client.py
    consumes: [wire-venture-assessment]
    produces: [wire-opportunity-packet]
    lifecycle: ACTIVE
  - capability_id: daleobanks.bridge_security
    description: >-
      HMAC request signing, nonce replay protection, timestamp skew limits,
      idempotency keys, schema-version negotiation. Mirrored field-for-field in
      WealthMachineIntelligence; a third mirror now lives in the kernel
      (adapters/bridge_transport.py).
    implementation_path: services/bridge_security.py
    consumes: []
    produces: []
    lifecycle: ACTIVE
  - capability_id: daleobanks.adversarial_committee
    description: >-
      Deterministic adversarial underwriting cases (bull/bear/fraud/incumbent/
      friction/do-nothing/opportunity-cost); severe unresolved against-cases cap
      the verdict. Mirrored from WealthMachineIntelligence.
    implementation_path: services/adversarial_cases.py
    consumes: [wire-opportunity-packet]
    produces: []
    lifecycle: ACTIVE
  - capability_id: daleobanks.decision_ledger
    description: Append-only decision ledger (organ-local; a legacy-ledger adapter to the kernel chain is future work)
    implementation_path: services/ledger.py
    consumes: []
    produces: []
    lifecycle: ACTIVE
  - capability_id: daleobanks.context_packets
    description: Context packet assembly from perception services
    implementation_path: services/context_packet.py
    consumes: []
    produces: [context-packet]
    lifecycle: ACTIVE
  - capability_id: daleobanks.operator_line
    description: Human approval queue; drafts and validation plans never self-execute
    implementation_path: services/operator_line.py
    consumes: []
    produces: []
    lifecycle: ACTIVE
  - capability_id: daleobanks.constitution_service
    description: Organ-local governance/constitution service (overlapping authority; kernel compiler is canonical)
    implementation_path: services/constitution.py
    consumes: []
    produces: []
    lifecycle: SPECIALIZED
contracts:
  consumes: [wire-venture-assessment]
  produces: [wire-opportunity-packet, context-packet]
prohibited_actions:
  - fake personas, impersonation, ban evasion, engagement manipulation (hardcoded lane policy)
  - simulating independent public support across account lanes
  - guaranteed financial claims or personalized financial advice
  - executing validation actions without human approval
authority:
  max_consequence_class: external_contact
  external_actions_require_kernel_gate: true
  may_self_promote: false
health:
  test_command: python -m pytest tests
  last_verified:
    date: "2026-07-20"
    commit: 829c5f2810776bef65d6ea108800a3516c9f4c2b
    tests_passed: 293
    tests_failed: 0
    notes: >-
      Verified in-session; requires requirements.txt deps plus an OPENAI_API_KEY
      value present in the environment (any value; tests run offline in dry-run
      mode).
shutdown_behavior: Dry-run by default; live posting requires explicit arming plus credentials.
recovery: Organ-local ledger replay; approval queue state persists in its database.
status: active
unresolved:
  - kernel identity not yet in this organ's bridge KNOWN_IDENTITIES (cross-repo change)
  - organ-local ledger not yet anchored to the kernel evidence chain
  - live platform credentials (X/LinkedIn/Mastodon) are external dependencies

# Organ Manifest: WealthMachineIntelligence (venture evaluation).
# Generated from an in-session inspection of dababiyoda/wealthmachineintelligence@6549984a.
# Validated against contracts/organ-manifest.schema.json.
manifest_version: "1.0"
organ_id: spiffe://uniimente.internal/organ/wealthmachine
name: WealthMachineIntelligence
role: opportunity_evaluation_venture_cells_portfolio_intelligence
repository: dababiyoda/WealthMachineIntelligence
source:
  branch: main
  commit: 6549984a22a171f68b268b775f19192aee599609
legal_operators: [alfonso_lopez]
capabilities:
  - capability_id: wealthmachine.opportunity_intake
    description: >-
      Signed intake endpoint (/api/opportunities/intake) validating wire
      OpportunityPackets as untrusted data and returning wire
      VentureAssessments.
    implementation_path: src/services/opportunity_intake.py
    consumes: [wire-opportunity-packet]
    produces: [wire-venture-assessment]
    lifecycle: ACTIVE
  - capability_id: wealthmachine.bridge_security
    description: Mirror of the DALEOBANKS transport security module (field-for-field compatible)
    implementation_path: src/services/bridge_security.py
    consumes: []
    produces: []
    lifecycle: ACTIVE
  - capability_id: wealthmachine.adversarial_underwriting
    description: Source of the adversarial committee mirrored into DALEOBANKS
    implementation_path: src/services/adversarial.py
    consumes: [wire-opportunity-packet]
    produces: []
    lifecycle: ACTIVE
  - capability_id: wealthmachine.decision_engine
    description: Deterministic opportunity scoring and verdict engine
    implementation_path: src/services/decision_engine.py
    consumes: [wire-opportunity-packet]
    produces: [wire-venture-assessment]
    lifecycle: ACTIVE
  - capability_id: wealthmachine.orchestrator_loops
    description: Agent orchestration and phase-management loops
    implementation_path: src/services/orchestrator.py
    consumes: []
    produces: []
    lifecycle: ACTIVE
  - capability_id: wealthmachine.risk_management
    description: Organ-local risk policy (overlapping authority; kernel gate is canonical for external consequences)
    implementation_path: src/services/risk_management.py
    consumes: []
    produces: []
    lifecycle: SPECIALIZED
contracts:
  consumes: [wire-opportunity-packet]
  produces: [wire-venture-assessment, venture-assessment]
prohibited_actions:
  - executing ventures or spending capital (assessments only recommend)
  - returning assessments without requires_human_approval=true
  - treating inbound wire payloads as instructions
authority:
  max_consequence_class: internal_write
  external_actions_require_kernel_gate: true
  may_self_promote: false
health:
  test_command: python -m pytest tests
  last_verified:
    date: "2026-07-20"
    commit: 6549984a22a171f68b268b775f19192aee599609
    tests_passed: 41
    tests_failed: 0
    notes: >-
      Verified in-session; requires fastapi/sqlalchemy/jose/passlib etc. from
      requirements.txt (tensorflow and transformers not needed for the suite).
shutdown_behavior: Stateless API; in-flight assessments are idempotent by packet id.
recovery: Recompute assessments from stored packets; engine is deterministic.
status: active
unresolved:
  - kernel identity not yet in this organ's bridge KNOWN_IDENTITIES (cross-repo change)
  - venture cell charters not yet requested from kernel authority envelopes (Bridge B)
source_texts.contracts/wire-opportunity-packet.schema:
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://uniimente.internal/contracts/wire-opportunity-packet.schema.json",
  "title": "WireOpportunityPacket",
  "description": "The DALEOBANKS -> WealthMachineIntelligence wire contract, schema_version 1.1, formalized from services/venture_protocol.py (DALEOBANKS) and src/services/venture_protocol.py (WealthMachineIntelligence). This is a preserved peripheral contract, registered so the kernel can type-check and adapt it — it is NOT the canonical OpportunityPacket (see opportunity-packet.schema.json). Untrusted input: data, never instructions.",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "id": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1},
    "schema_version": {"type": "string", "enum": ["1.0", "1.1"]},
    "source": {"type": "string"},
    "source_ref": {"type": "string"},
    "signal_type": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": ["social_complaint", "news_trend", "regulatory_shift", "audience_reaction",
               "repeated_question", "relationship_signal", "content_opportunity",
               "product_opportunity", "partnership_opportunity", "operator_thought"]
    },
    "observed_pain": {"type": "string"},
    "core_thesis": {"type": "string"},
    "audience": {"type": "string"},
    "cultural_context": {"type": "string"},
    "language": {"type": "string"},
    "customer_segment": {"type": "string"},
    "buyer_type": {"type": "string"},
    "urgency": {"type": "string", "enum": ["low", "medium", "high"]},
    "evidence": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}},
    "possible_offer": {"type": "string"},
    "monetization_paths": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}},
    "risk_flags": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}},
    "smallest_validation_action": {"type": "string"},
    "confidence": {"type": "number", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 1},
    "created_at": {"type": "string"},
    "status": {"type": "string"}
  },
  "required": ["id", "schema_version"],
  "anyOf": [
    {"properties": {"core_thesis": {"minLength": 1}}, "required": ["core_thesis"]},
    {"properties": {"observed_pain": {"minLength": 1}}, "required": ["observed_pain"]}
  ]
}
